blocks.html: In the Special Bay Ridge District, the height and setback and maximum building height regulations of the underlying districts have been modified as follows:
blocks.plainText: In the Special Bay Ridge District, the height and setback and maximum building height regulations of the underlying districts have been modified as follows:

blocks.html:
1. In C8-2 Districts

    In C8-2 Districts, the maximum height of a building or other structure shall be 70 feet. Any portion of a building or other structure that exceeds a height of 60 feet shall be set back with a depth of at least 10 feet from a wide street line and at least 15 feet from a narrow street line.
  2. For community facilities in Residence Districts

    In R3A, R3X, R3-2, R4A, R4-1, R4B and R5B Districts, the maximum height of a community facility building shall not exceed 32 feet.

blocks.html: However, energy infrastructure equipment and accessory mechanical equipment shall be permitted obstructions above such height limits, subject to the provisions of Sections 24-51 or 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions), as applicable.
